newsitem.title: FRANCE: French bonds end higher, supported by dollar.
newsitem.headline: French bonds end higher, supported by dollar.

text.p: 1550 GMT - September bond futures ended higher, supported by a slight dollar slide against the mark. Higher Treasury bonds, despite a rise in the Philadelphia Fed index, also lend support.
*5.50 2007 OAT yield 5.42 pct vs 5.47.Bund spread -13 bp vs -14
*Call money unch at 3-1/8 1/4 pct. Sept PIBOR 96.50, up 1bp
